Sharding._comment: TK-46. A pooled tenant database holds CustomersPerPool customers. When every pool is full, or for an Elite customer, the next StandbyDatabases entry not yet registered is migrated and registered. Outside Development the app creates no database (D-02): list only databases infrastructure has created. In Development, with no standby left, the next Prefix + 6-digit name is created.

Bootstrap._comment: The first account, created once and only while mst.Users is empty. Set OwnerEmail to create it; it is created with no password, so the only way in is the forgot-password flow against that mailbox. Leave blank to create nothing.
Bootstrap._operatorComment: Platform operators (D-01): every existing user with one of these addresses gets IsPlatformOperator, and with it platform.* and the /admin pages, at each startup. Comma- or semicolon-separated. Grant-only; an operator revokes through the /admin pages.
Bootstrap._internalAddOnsComment: The first customer is the Internal one (our own organisation) and its head office is a Service branch (TK-153). Its add-ons, comma-separated (e.g. "Hrms, Payroll"); any a Service branch cannot have is left off and logged. None by default.
Bootstrap._demoComment: Demo customers (TK-154): one per business type, master data only. SeedDemoCustomers makes them on start (off by default, so production never gets them by accident); an operator can also make them from the admin Customers page. Their owners sign in as plus-addresses of DemoOwnerEmail (falling back to OwnerEmail), with no password: use forgot-password.
